brief: Your typography is your brand voice — 6 examples of brands getting it right.

slots.body: Six iconic brands prove that choosing the right typeface builds instant recognition and lasting trust.

slots.title: Clarity Meets
slots.body: Apple’s San Francisco typeface is engineered for screens of every size. Its open apertures and tall x-height ensure effortless reading across devices.

slots.title: Impact Through
slots.body: Nike wields heavy sans-serif weights and tight tracking to command attention instantly. The result feels athletic, urgent, and impossible to ignore.
slots.quote: Type should move as fast as the athlete.

slots.title: Heritage in Every
slots.body: The iconic Spencerian script has remained virtually unchanged for over a century. That flowing, human handwriting signals authenticity and nostalgic joy.
slots.quote: Tradition is a typeface you never outgrow.

slots.title: Elegance Through
slots.body: Chanel pairs clean sans-serif wordmarks with high-contrast serifs in editorial layouts. Thin hairlines and generous spacing whisper luxury without shouting.

slots.title: Friendly Digital
slots.body: Product Sans uses perfect circles and balanced proportions to feel approachable yet confident. The custom lettering removes serifs but keeps warmth.

slots.title: Authority in Black
slots.body: Cheltenham and custom variants carry the weight of journalistic history. Dense columns of sharp serifs promise rigor, depth, and unwavering credibility.
Audit your fonts today and align every letter with the voice you want the world to hear.
